title: Allocation Tracker 与对象分配热点定位
key_conclusions: Allocation Tracker or allocation recording answers who allocates, how much is allocated, which call stack is responsible, and whether churn or peaks create GC pressure.
Allocation hotspots are not leak proof; leak proof requires post-GC retained evidence from HPROF, MAT, LeakCanary, or Shark.
Cold start, page entry, list scrolling, search input, image decoding, JSON parsing, and string formatting are high-value allocation windows.
A fix should be accepted only when before/after allocation count and size, GC pressure, post-GC baseline, retained paths, and relevant resource metrics improve together.
shallow_points: The article still describes allocation recording workflows without a real Android Studio allocation export.
It does not validate Android Studio version-specific allocation recording fields, export behavior, or API-level differences.
It does not include a concrete Perfetto trace tying allocation churn to frame jank and GC slices.
It does not provide runnable benchmark scripts or allocation budgets for a sample app.
